'''Braconnor Bakiska''' was a [[Stennes Shifter]] who was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the former [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered. He sat at a table in the establishment's backrooms with fellow patrons [[Bom Vimdin]], [[Pons Limbic]], [[Hem Dazon]], and [[Arleil Schous]].

==Biography==
[[File:HemDazonCL.png|thumb|right|250px|Braconnor Bakiska (bottom right) spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]]
Braconnor Bakiska was a [[Stennes Shifter]] who spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> While in the [[cantina]], he sat at a table<ref name="AEYNTK" /> in one of the establishment's backrooms<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> with several other patrons: the [[Arcona]] [[Hem Dazon]], the [[Advozse]] [[Bom Vimdin]], the [[Defel]] [[Arleil Schous]], and the [[Siniteen]] [[Pons Limbic]].<ref name="AEYNTK" />

While the group sat together, a pair of [[human]]s—the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the former [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]]—entered the establishment looking for a [[pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Shortly after the humans arrived, Vimdin, Bakiska, and Dazon were still sitting together at the table with several other patrons when Skywalker and Kenobi got into an altercation with the criminals [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]] at the cantina's bar.<ref name="CL" />

==Personality and traits==
Bakiska had [[Color|tan]] skin, brown [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]], including a mustache. Like many members of his [[species]], he was hyper-wary of strangers.<ref name="AEYNTK" />

==Equipment==
While at the cantina, Bakiska wore a brown [[Clothing|hood]] over a tan shirt.<ref name="AEYNTK" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Production===
{{Quote|Yeah, that's my Frankenstein, but I don't know who put that stupid mustache on him!|Rick Baker|<ref name="Braconnor">{{SW|url=news/meet-braconnor-bakiska|text=Meet Braconnor Bakiska}}</ref>}}
[[File:Bakiska-Limbic-BTS.png|thumb|left|300px|Braconnor Bakiska was filmed during pick-up photography on ''A New Hope''.]]
Braconnor Bakiska first appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|Star Wars: Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH" /> which was released on [[May 25]], [[1977]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character's single shot in the film was filmed as part of pick-up photography<ref name="Braconnor" /> in post-production where supplemental footage was shot for the cantina sequence<ref name="Beastmaster">{{InsiderCite|126|The Beastmaster!}}</ref> on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]] and [[January 25|25]], 1977,<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>

The character's mask was a re-use of the mask used for another cantina character, [[Trinto Duaba]], which itself was based on a slip-on commercial [[Wikipedia:Halloween|Halloween]] mask called "Terminal Man" that [[Rick Baker]] produced as an original take on [[Wikipedia:Frankenstein's monster|Frankenstein's monster]]; a reconstructed man with electric terminals on his head. Baker and [[Laine Liska]] were then responsible for creating the mask used in the film, although Baker does not know who added the mustache, which he considers stupid. Although the character had no production nickname, fans would later dub him "[[Wikipedia:Fu Manchu moustache|Fu Manchu]]" based on the mustache.<ref name="Braconnor" />

===Naming===
{{Quote|Despite over three decades of scrutiny, this shifty looking barfly had managed to avoid the spotlight. So, Tom and I figured we'd give him his due, and also come up with a way to give him a name.|Pablo Hidalgo|<ref name="Braconnor" />}}
[[File:BrandonConnorsTomSpina-CelebrationVI.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Braconnor Bakiska was partially named after Brandon Connors (left) at Celebration VI.]]
The character would not receive an official name in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity until ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration VI]] on [[August 25]], [[2012]],<ref name="Panel">{{SW|url=news/exploring-the-creature-cantina-at-celebration-vi|text=Exploring the Creature Cantina at Celebration VI}}</ref> during the "[[Behind the Scenes of the Cantina]]" panel hosted by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Tom Spina]]. When preparing the panel, the pair both gravitated toward the character and decided to provide him with a name to make the panel a memorable event. Wanting some control over the name, they created the surname Bakiska as a [[tuckerization]] of Baker and Liska's names, with the plan being to create the forename based on one of the panel attendees. Spina recreated the mask as an additional prize for the chosen attendee, and prior to the event, postcards featuring the character [[Zutton|Snaggletooth]] were handed out to guests.<ref name="Braconnor" />

One of these cards had a hand-drawn mustache added to it, and during the panel Hidalgo and Spina had everyone check their cards for the mustache in order to reveal the winner. Although some of the seven hundred plus attendees had already left prior to this point, [[Brandon Connors]] revealed that he had the mustachioed card, and Hidalgo initially created the forename "Braconner" based on Connors' name. The spelling was then changed to "Braconnor" at Spina's suggestion, as while Hidalgo was more interested in a phonetic Tuckerism, Spina suggested it should more closely resemble Connors' name since that was the point of the competition.<ref name="Braconnor" /> The name was then first used in [[canon]] in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK" />
